subject: demo-agent-joe-001

checks.name: seal signature
checks.detail: key mismatch: seal was not created by this key (possible key substitution or wrong key)

scope: Structure, identity consistency, lifecycle state machine, evidence content hashes, evidence root, and the seal signature of this submission package only. Ed25519 seals are verified publicly in every mode; HMAC seals only in strict --key mode.
limitations: HMAC-SHA256 seals (v0.2) are symmetric: verification requires the owner key. Ed25519 seals (v0.3) are third-party verifiable with the public key recorded in the seal.
Key substitution is detectable only when verifying with the owner key (--key), a pinned public key (--pubkey), or out-of-band key pinning.
Evidence Root algorithm is provisional (pending canonical serialization ratification).
Lifecycle event signatures (event.signature) are not ratified and not verified.
No behavioral evaluation is performed (Evaluation is out of verifier scope, archive SS15).
statement: Violations were detected within the observed evidence boundary.
